title: Python is named after a comedy troupe
body: Guido van Rossum named his language after Monty Python's Flying Circus, whose scripts he was reading when he started in 1989. He wanted a short, mysterious name; the snake came later as a logo. The documentation still hides Python (the comedy) references for those who read closely.
source_hint: van Rossum, Python history / Foreword for Programming Perl
